messages.author: 88fc9e4621d0a6d6
messages.subject: legend positioning
parts:
Dear Group,

I'm trying to change the position of the legend in my plot.
I'd like to have it at the bottom, aligned hoizontally but I have 2
problems:
A) legend.position="bottom" gives me an error

Error in grid.Call.graphics("L_setviewport", pvp, TRUE) :
Non-finite location and/or size for viewport

but this can be fixed by setting a margin an positioning the
legend manually with c(x,y)

B) legend.direction = "horizontal" does not change anything, the
legend keeps being
in vertical alignment.

How can I fix this?

Thx for your help!

change upon change of the legend.direction command.

ggplot(mtcars, aes(factor(cyl), fill=factor(cyl))) + geom_bar() +
opts(legend.position=c(0.1,0.1), legend.direction = "horizontal",
